about_the_game:
Notice to All Players

  • This game contains heavy themes, including domestic violence.
    If you have trauma related to family or similar subjects, please proceed with caution.

A boy who ran away from home.

He settles beneath a bridge, spending his days busking.

In this new routine, he experiences new encounters and small, unexpected happenings.

Why did he leave home?

And what will await him at the end of this short journey?

Enjoy a story that feels like a short musical film, capturing a boy’s fleeting journey.

A short experience of around 2 hours, combining Visual Novel, Rhythm Game, and Adventure.

It features a linear story to follow along,

enriched with mini-games such as the rhythm game [Busking] and the music puzzle [Songwriting].

A Quiet and Restrained Story

This script is based on the developer’s real life.

It doesn’t try to force emotion—

it simply unfolds in a calm yet honest way.

An Original Live Acoustic Soundtrack

All tracks are written, composed, performed, and recorded by the developer.

From the protagonist’s own songs to in-world “hit songs” performed on busking stages,

experience music that connects directly with the story.

Solo Development

Every illustration, every line of writing, and every piece of music was created by the developer alone.

Because this story is entirely mine, I wanted it to be told only through me.

Streaming & Content Creation Guidelines

  • There are no restrictions on live streaming this game,
    and broadcasting the full game content, including the ending, is fully permitted.
    Uploading gameplay footage or archived live stream videos is also allowed without limitation.

  • There are also no restrictions on creating secondary content such as videos, reviews, or commentary related to the game.

  • However, if edited, summarized, commentary-based, or review-style content
    seriously misrepresents the game through false or misleading information,
    the developer may request that such content be removed or made private,
    and content creators are expected to comply with this request.

  • Additionally, if such produced content
    contains spoilers related to major parts of the game,
    content creators are requested to clearly indicate the presence of spoilers
    at least once in a visible location, such as the thumbnail, title,
    or at the beginning of the content.
